newsitem.title: USA: Riscorp says names Dawson chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Riscorp says names Dawson chief executive.

text.p: RISCORP Inc said Tuesday that it has named Frederick Dawson as its new chief executive.
Dawson succeeds William Griffin as chief executive. Griffin will remain company chairman, the company said.

Riscorp, a managed care workers' compensation company, said Dawson had served as chairman and chief executive of Integon Life Insurance Corp and also as chairman and chief executive of Harcourt General Insurance Cos in Florida before joining Riscorp.
It said Dawson was appointed under a two-year employment contract and elected as a company director.
